```{r phased-loci}
# per-block decisions
df_decisions    <- as.data.frame(ls_results$blocks)
df_decisions$PS <- as.character(df_decisions$PS)
df_decisions$P  <- NA
df_decisions$anchor_tier <- NA

# decisions from the block pairing: a block inherits the anchor's decision (pairing I) or its opposite (pairing II)
fn_anchor   <- file.path(outdir_pairing, "anchors.tsv")
fn_pairings <- file.path(outdir_pairing, "block_pairings.tsv")

if (all(file.exists(fn_anchor, fn_pairings))) {
    # open input files
    df_anchor   <- data.table::fread(fn_anchor)
    df_pairings <- data.table::fread(fn_pairings)

    # extract accepted blocks
    df_pairings    <- df_pairings[df_pairings$accepted, ]
    df_pairings$PS <- as.character(df_pairings$PS)

    # merge with df_anchor
    df_pairings <- merge(df_pairings, df_anchor[, c("locus", "anchor_tier", "anchor_decision")], by="locus")

    # create a lookup table for keeping or flipping the blocks
    flip <- c(keep="flip", flip="keep")
    df_pairings$decision <- ifelse(df_pairings$pairing == "I", df_pairings$anchor_decision, flip[df_pairings$anchor_decision])
    df_pairings$tier     <- "paired"

    # report blocks whose paired decision contradicts their own placement
    id_block     <- paste(df_decisions$locus, df_decisions$PS)
    id_pairing   <- paste(df_pairings$locus, df_pairings$PS)

    id_match     <- match(id_pairing, id_block)
    is_conflict  <- df_decisions$decision[id_match] %in% c("keep", "flip") & df_decisions$decision[id_match] != df_pairings$decision
    log4r::info(fn_logger, paste0("Block pairing: ", nrow(df_pairings), " blocks oriented by pairing, ",
                                  sum(is_conflict), " contradicting their own placement decision"))

    # extract all blocks, with paired decisions taking precedence
    cols         <- c("locus", "PS", "decision", "tier", "P", "anchor_tier")
    df_decisions <- rbind(df_decisions[!id_block %in% id_pairing, cols], df_pairings[, cols])
}

# set a criterion for a strict paired decision
is_paired_strict <- df_decisions$tier == "paired" &
                    df_decisions$anchor_tier == "both" &
                    pmax(df_decisions$P, 1 - df_decisions$P) >= 0.99

# create two sets of phased loci
ls_sets <- list(both   = df_decisions[df_decisions$tier == "both" | is_paired_strict, ],
                single = df_decisions[df_decisions$tier %in% c("both", "single", "paired"), ])
ls_sets <- lapply(ls_sets, function(x) { x[x$decision %in% c("keep", "flip"), ] })
sapply(names(ls_sets), function(x) { dir.create(file.path(outdir_phased, x), recursive=T, showWarnings=F) })

# create doSNOW cluster
nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

# iterate over loci
ls_locus <- gsub("_filtered\\.fna$", "", list.files(outdir_blocks_cds, pattern="_filtered\\.fna$"))

df_summary <- foreach(locus = ls_locus, .combine='rbind') %dopar% {
    # open the block sequence
    block_cds <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(file.path(outdir_blocks_cds, paste0(locus, "_filtered.fna")))

    # iterate over individual sets
    ls_out <- lapply(names(ls_sets), function(set) {
        df_blocks <- ls_sets[[set]][ls_sets[[set]]$locus == locus, ]
        if (nrow(df_blocks) == 0) {
            return(NULL)
        }

        # extract the haplotype blocks
        haps        <- f_build_phased_locus(block_cds, df_blocks)
        names(haps) <- paste0(params$sample, "_", names(haps))
        Biostrings::writeXStringSet(haps, filepath=file.path(outdir_phased, set, paste0(locus, ".fna")))

        data.table::data.table(set        = set,
                               locus      = locus,
                               n_oriented = nrow(df_blocks),
                               n_sites    = sum(strsplit(as.character(haps[[1]]), "")[[1]] != "N"))
    })
    
    return(data.table::rbindlist(ls_out))
}

stopCluster(nwcl)

# save the summary
data.table::fwrite(df_summary, file=file.path(outdir_phased, "phased_loci_summary.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F)

# update the log file
n_oriented <- tapply(df_summary$n_oriented, df_summary$set, sum)
readr::write_lines(c("", paste0("Phased loci: h0 = ", ls_results$lineage_A, ", h1 = ", ls_results$lineage_B),
                     paste0("Oriented blocks: ", paste(names(n_oriented), n_oriented, sep="=", collapse=", "))),
                   file=fn_log, append=T)
```

```{r phased-tree}
# create doSNOW cluster
nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

# iterate over sets
for (set in names(ls_sets)) {
    # extract the list of locus
    ls_locus <- list.files(file.path(outdir_phased, set), recursive=F, full.names=F)
    ls_locus <- gsub("\\_combined\\.fna", "", ls_locus)
    ls_locus <- gsub("\\.fna", "", ls_locus)
    ls_locus <- unique(ls_locus)

    # create output directory
    dir_aln_set <- file.path(outdir_alignment, set)
    if (!dir.exists(dir_aln_set)) {
        dir.create(dir_aln_set, recursive=T)
    }

    # iterate over loci
    foreach (locus = ls_locus) %dopar% {
        # input files
        fn_ref    <- file.path(params$dir_backbone_alignment, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
        fn_query  <- file.path(outdir_phased, set, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
        fn_query_tool     <- file.path(outdir_best_hits_cds, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
        fn_query_combined <- file.path(outdir_phased, set, paste0(locus, "_combined.fna"))

        # combine the two haplotypes and CAPTUS output
        seq_query             <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(fn_query)
        seq_query_tool        <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(fn_query_tool)
        names(seq_query_tool) <- paste0(params$sample, "_", tool)
        seq_query             <- c(seq_query, seq_query_tool)
        Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq_query, filepath=fn_query_combined)

        # MAFFT --add
        fn_output_alignment <- file.path(dir_aln_set, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
        f_mafft_add(fn_ref    = fn_ref,
                    fn_sample = fn_query_combined,
                    fn_out    = fn_output_alignment,
                    exe_mafft = params$exe_mafft)

        # remove '_R_' for reverse-complemented sequence
        aln <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(fn_output_alignment)
        names(aln) <- gsub("^_R_", "", names(aln))
        Biostrings::writeXStringSet(aln, filepath=fn_output_alignment)
    }

    # create output directory
    dir_tree_set <- file.path(outdir_tree, set)
    if (!dir.exists(dir_tree_set)) {
        dir.create(dir_tree_set, recursive=T)
    }

    # concatenate alignment
    f_amas_dna(input_regex    = file.path(dir_aln_set, "*.fna"),
               fn_output_aln  = file.path(dir_tree_set, "concatenated.out"),
               fn_output_part = file.path(dir_tree_set, "partitions.nex"),
               exe_amas       = params$exe_amas)

    # convert Ns to gaps
    f_unknown2gap(fn_fasta  = file.path(dir_tree_set, "concatenated.out"),
                  fn_output = file.path(dir_tree_set, "concatenated.fna"))

    # extract best model per locus
    fn_partition <- file.path(dir_tree_set, "partitions_with_models.nex")
    df_partition <- f_extract_best_models(params$file_backbone_genetree_models, file.path(dir_tree_set, "partitions.nex"))

    # write the partitions and models
    con <- file(fn_partition, "w")
    writeLines("#nexus", con)
    writeLines("begin sets;", con)

    # add charset lines
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_partition))) {
    writeLines(sprintf("    charset %s = %s;", df_partition$locus[i], df_partition$coords[i]),
                con=con)
    }

    # add models
    ls_partition <- sprintf("%s:%s", df_partition$model, df_partition$locus)
    ls_partition <- paste(ls_partition, collapse=", ")
    writeLines(sprintf("    charpartition mine = %s;", ls_partition),
            con=con)

    writeLines("end;", con)
    close(con)

    # infer IQ-TREE tree
    f_iqtree2_fixtop(fn_input     = file.path(dir_tree_set, "concatenated.fna"),
                     fn_tree      = params$file_backbone_speciestree,
                     fn_partition = fn_partition,
                     prefix       = file.path(dir_tree_set, "iqtree"),
                     thread       = params$thread,
                     is_redo      = params$redo,
                     exe_iqtree2  = params$exe_iqtree)
}

stopCluster(nwcl)
```
